model_manifest.training_policy: no fitting: the table is a frozen published physics calculation; fit() records training identities and lattice only
model_manifest.uncertainty_method: within-model sigma = the table's own empirical rms deviation against the experimental masses quoted in the same file, computed at parse time

residual_gp_config.feature_scaling: per-feature standardization from the fit set only

model_manifest.training_policy: GP on (evaluated_mass - base_model_mass) over freeze-approved training observations with an AVAILABLE base prediction; uncovered pairs are skipped and counted, never imputed
model_manifest.uncertainty_method: residual_std_keV = correction-GP posterior sigma (includes the fitted white-noise level); the base model's within-model sigma is not added on top, because the correction replaces the base error model inside the fitted domain

calibration.rule: uniform: no data enters the weights

calibration.truth_rule: weights learned from training-side calibration data only; hidden benchmark truth never enters
